sections.overview:
The Netresearch Agentic Skills Marketplace provides 40 curated, portable skill packages designed for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex. Skills cover TYPO3 development, PHP modernization, Docker setup, Jira integration, security audits, and documentation workflows. Each skill encapsulates procedural knowledge following the Agent Skills specification, enabling agents to understand and work within your specific tech stack. Installation is straightforward via Claude Code marketplace or npx, making it easy to extend your agent's capabilities for enterprise development, code quality, and infrastructure tasks.
TYPO3 extension development, testing, upgrades, and documentation
PHP 8.x modernization with type safety and modern patterns
Docker containerization and multi-stage build configuration
Security audits and supply chain compliance (OWASP, OpenSSF, SLSA)
- **Company**: GreenTech Solutions
- **Industry**: Renewable Energy
- **Project Type**: Custom TYPO3 Extension
- **Specific Task**: Implementing a dynamic energy consumption dashboard

Mỗi kỹ năng đóng gói các kiến thức quy trình theo đặc tả Agent Skills, giúp agent hiểu và làm việc trực tiếp trên tech stack cụ thể của bạn. Kiểm định bảo mật và tuân thủ chuỗi cung ứng (OWASP, OpenSSF, SLSA)
